title: Two rollout switches break the .env.example / RUNBOOKS rule: the stylesheet pilot has no activation gate and the cron heartbeat skip list is missing from .env.example.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: CONFIRMED. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: SITE_THEME_STYLESHEET_PILOT is read at components/sites/site-theme-stylesheet.ts:12 and listed in .env.example but absent from docs/RUNBOOKS.md; CRON_HEARTBEAT_SKIP read at lib/observability/cron-heartbeat.ts:64 and documented in RUNBOOKS but not in .env.example. All other envFlag switches (33) are in both.

WHY IT MATTERS: A switch with no gate is flipped on guesswork; an env var absent from .env.example is invisible to whoever provisions a new environment.

FIX DIRECTION: Add the RUNBOOKS gate line and the .env.example entry.

FIXED 2026-11-16: CRON_HEARTBEAT_SKIP is in .env.example with its gate pointer, and docs/RUNBOOKS.md has a Site theme stylesheet pilot section for SITE_THEME_STYLESHEET_PILOT.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
